sentences.text: Bolivosteus chacomensis is a rhenanid placoderm, a type of armored fish, found in the Eifelian of Bolivia.
This species is known from skull fragments and scales.
The genus Bolivosteus was described by Goujet, Janvier, and Suarez-Riglos in 1986.
Bolivosteus is classified as a genus.
It belongs to the order Rhenanida.
The animal is a member of the class Placodermi.
Bolivosteus is assigned to the family Asterosteidae.
The only known species in the genus is B. chacomensis.
Fossils of Bolivosteus date to the Eifelian stage.
The Malvinokaffric faunas, where Bolivosteus was found, represent cold-water ecosystems near or at the South Pole during the Middle Devonian.
